events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Today marks the 75th birthday of Chrissie Hynde, the iconic American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, born in Akron, Ohio on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her influence with The Pretenders continues to rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive lead singer of Oasis and later Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday today, having been born in Manchester, England, on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Britpop Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo studio album, 'Imagine', was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring his signature title track.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message, still as relevant today.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket' and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? 25 years since Apple unveiled the device that changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day – celebrating over six decades of 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The legendary co-founder of The Beatles was born on October 9, 1940, in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: John Lennon would have turned 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, as a double album.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the monumental 'White Album'. A double LP that broke all the rules.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in the band's artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles' iconic album that pushed boundaries and defined a new sound.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years since we lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.
